lines: Seat 1 chooses Golemwright: at the end, 1 point per 3 Golems you have, up to 3.
Bid 3 mana on the Wild tile at (2, 0) (yields 4).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 3 and keep 6 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 2 chooses Weaver: at the end, 1 point per 2 tiles in your largest connected group beyond the first 2, up to 3.
Bid 3 mana on the Steady tile at (0, 2) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 3 and keep 6 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 2 wins the Steady tile at (0, 2) (yields 2) for 3 mana.
Seat 3 wins the Wild tile at (2, 0) (yields 4) for 4 mana.
Seat 1 gets the Wild tile at (-1, 0) (yields 1) for free.
Bid 2 mana on the Wild tile at (-1, 2) (yields 4).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 2 and keep 4 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Bid 4 mana on the Wild tile at (-2, 1) (yields 4).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 4 and keep 5 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
A tie for the Wild tile at (-1, 2) (yields 4) at 2 mana: nobody gets it.
Seat 1 wins the Wild tile at (-2, 1) (yields 4) for 4 mana.
Seat 2 gets the Wild tile at (-1, 2) (yields 4) for free.
Seat 3 gets the Shifting tile at (-2, 0) (yields 3) for free.
Pass: you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Pass: you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 3 wins the Shifting tile at (2, -1) (yields 3) for 2 mana.
Seat 1 gets the Steady tile at (-1, -1) (yields 2) for free.
Seat 2 gets the Steady tile at (0, -1) (yields 2) for free.
The opening is over. The rounds begin.
Every trait stays secret until the end. Guess a rival's alongside your orders, once per rival.
Round 1 of 8 begins.
Seat 1 collects 7 mana.
Seat 2 collects 8 mana.
Seat 3 collects 10 mana.
Summon 4 Golems at (-1, 0) for 8 mana, leaving 4.
Attune the Shifting tile at (1, -2) (yields 1) for 4 mana, leaving 10. If a rival attunes it too, nobody gets it.
Round 1.
Seat 2 attunes the Shifting tile at (1, -2) (yields 1) for 4 mana.
Seat 3 attunes the Shifting tile at (1, -1) (yields 1) for 4 mana.
Seat 1 summons 4 Golems at (-1, 0).
Seat 3 casts Blight on the Wild tile at (-2, 1) (yields 4): it yields nothing next round.
Seat 1 banks 1 point (1 for land, 0 for mana), 1 in all.
Seat 2 banks 1 point (1 for land, 0 for mana), 1 in all.
Seat 3 banks 2 points (1 for land, 1 for mana), 2 in all.
Round 2 of 8 begins.
An Unveil reveals the Shifting tile at (0, -2) (yields 1); the Shifting tile at (-2, 2) (yields 3, guarded by power 3); the Wild tile at (0, 1) (yields 1); the Steady tile at (0, 0) (yields 2).
Seat 1 collects 3 mana.
Seat 1 pays 4 mana upkeep.
Seat 2 collects 9 mana.
Seat 3 collects 11 mana.
Attune the Wild tile at (0, 1) (yields 1) for 7 mana, leaving 12. If a rival attunes it too, nobody gets it.

Attack the Shifting tile at (-2, 0) (yields 3) (Seat 3's, held by no units, power 0) with 3 Golems (power 9). As things stand, you win and take it, keeping 3 Golems. Units that attack don't defend their own tiles this round.
Round 2.
Seat 2 attunes the Wild tile at (0, 1) (yields 1) for 7 mana.
Seat 3 summons 4 Golems at (-2, 0).
Seat 3 casts Ward on (-2, 0): it defends with 3 more power this round.
Seat 1 (3 Golems) attack the Shifting tile at (-2, 0) (yields 3), Seat 3's, held by 4 Golems: power 9 against 15.
The attack fails: the attackers are wiped out. The defenders keep 2 Golems.
Seat 1 banks 2 points (1 for land, 1 for mana), 3 in all.
Seat 2 banks 3 points (2 for land, 1 for mana), 4 in all.
Seat 3 banks 2 points (1 for land, 1 for mana), 4 in all.
Round 3 of 8 begins.
Seat 1 collects 7 mana.
Seat 1 pays 1 mana upkeep.
Seat 2 collects 10 mana.
Seat 3 collects 11 mana.
Seat 3 pays 2 mana upkeep.
